company__culture__all-remote__drawbacks.md:54:- All-remote companies should not assume that team members will work from their home 100% of the time. Organizations can consider [reimbursing coworking space usage](/handbook/finance/spending-company-money/) and [creating an atmosphere](/handbook/finance/spending-company-money/) where team members are [encouraged to construct a workspace](/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/#fully-distributed-and-completely-connected) that is ideal for their comfort and productivity.
company__culture__all-remote__guide__people-operations.md:24:1. **Fundamentals:** It's easy to assume suddenly remote team members have all the pieces in place in their home to work productively. That would be a mistake. Survey team members immediately as to their [work-set up and urgent needs](../workspace/), e.g. a good desk chair, secure Internet connection, headphones for video conferences, etc. To the extent possible, offer to reimburse them for reasonable home office equipment.
company__culture__all-remote__the-gitlab-test-remote-work.md:85:### 12. Do you fund individual workspaces and reimburse for out-of-home office use?

company__culture__exec-connect.md:26:- **Travel reimbursement:** Up to $25 in local currency (e.g., Uber, rail, or local transport) — may vary slightly by location  
finance__accounting___index.md:445:### Team Member Reimbursements - Navan
finance__accounting___index.md:458:1. Team members in a US expense policy will be automatically reimbursed through Navan after their report is "final approved" within 1-4 business days.
finance__accounting___index.md:460:    - Once an team member is reimbursed, Navan will auto sync the payment to the expense record to mark the report as reimbursed.
finance__accounting___index.md:462:1. Team memebers in a country paid through PEO will also receive expense reimbursement through their same payroll PEO payments each month.
finance__accounting___index.md:463:    - **Please Note:**  The timing of reimbursement can vary if you are being reimbursed directly from payroll, CXC, SafeGuard, Global PEO, Remote and/or iiPay.
finance__accounting___index.md:464:    - More information on the timing of payouts can be found [here](https://internal.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#44-reimbursement-payout-timelines)
finance__accounting___index.md:465:1. All non-US GitLab entities will be reimbursed through their respective payroll provider or paid directly through GitLab's Accounts Payable (AP) department with the normal weekly payment run.
finance__accounting___index.md:467:    - Any report "final approved" on Wednesday to Friday of that week will be reimbursed the following week.
finance__accounting___index.md:468:    - Once an employee is reimbursed, AP will create the payment in NetSuite against the record to close the report as paid.
finance__accounting___index.md:469:    - AP will manually mark the expense reports as "Reimbursed" in Navan once they are confirmed to the payroll provider or batched to Tipalti.
finance__accounting___index.md:479:**Further details on the Expense reimbursement process can be found [here](https://internal.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#4-procedures)**
finance__accounting___index.md:485:    Number of days from when an team member's manager approves report to when AP analyst does final approval for payment or responds to team member in Navan if there is a concern. (Approval for payment is not the reimbursement date.) This is calculated on a calendar month basis. The target for this is currently three business days.
finance__accounting___index.md:504:### Non-Reimbursable Expenses
finance__accounting___index.md:506:In order to purchase goods and services on behalf of the company, you should first [consult the Signature Authorization Matrix](../authorization-matrix/) to determine the approval requirements. Note that this **does not** include travel expenses and other incidentals. These expenses should be self-funded then submitted for reimbursement within Navan, or in the case of independent contractors, included in invoices to the company (per the guidelines above).
finance__expenses.md:11:- Provide guidance around allowable reimbursable expenses.
finance__expenses.md:54:- Expenses for gifts and entertainment must be incurred and reimbursed in accordance with GitLab's [Gifts & Entertainment Policy](/handbook/legal/policies/gifts-contributions/#gifts-and-entertainment-policy) and [Antibribery Policy](/handbook/legal/anti-corruption-policy/).
finance__expenses.md:56:- Expense claims over 90 days from purchase date will not be reimbursed unless approved by the Manager.
finance__expenses.md:60:[Omitted long matching line]
finance__expenses.md:63:- Personal credits and gift cards: GitLab will reimburse only the actual out-of-pocket amount paid by the employee. If personal credits, gift cards, rewards points, or other discounts are applied to a business purchase, reimbursement will be limited to the net amount charged to the employee's personal payment method.
finance__expenses.md:64:Example: An employee purchases a $100 monitor and applies a $50 gift card. GitLab will reimburse $50 (the amount actually paid), not the pre-discount price of $100.
finance__expenses.md:67:- All work-related expenses (internet, co-working space, other monthly subscription, etc.) are not reimbursable while on Leave of any kind.
finance__expenses.md:68:[Omitted long matching line]
finance__expenses.md:75:- There will be occasions where if you have claimed an item and it needs to be reimbursed back to GitLab, you will need to follow the repayment process in Navan for submission of the funds.
finance__expenses.md:100:**Following expenses are categorized for reimbursement purposes with specific policy definition attached to it. The limits below are in USD, please use local currency equivalents when considering other currencies.**
finance__expenses.md:135:- Team Members may use personal frequent flyer miles or points for upgrades on business travel, however, Team Members will not be reimbursed for any respective charges.
finance__expenses.md:160:- Rental Cars are reimbursable and should be booked through Navan, up to the intermediate car class, with a 7 day booking lead time.
finance__expenses.md:185:In the event of an accident resulting in damage to the rental car, the Non-US rental agency will charge the credit card used to make the reservation with an estimated amount of repair costs if insurance is not purchased. If this happens, GitLab does not purchase Foreign Corporate Hired Auto Physical Damage Coverage to reimburse for damages.
finance__expenses.md:199:- Hotel stays are reimbursable up to $300 USD (or equivalent local currency) inclusive of tax per night for standard rooms, with a 7 day booking lead time.
finance__expenses.md:204:- Conference hotel room blocks or Corporate Events organized blocks will still need to be charged to a personal credit card and then submitted for reimbursement via Navan Expense.
finance__expenses.md:230:- Meals while traveling on Company business  are reimbursable, up to $120 USD (or local equivalent currency) per day.
finance__expenses.md:231:- Each Team Member must submit their own receipts for reimbursement, so ensure to separate billing when going to meals with groups of Team Members. If this is not practicable to do due to the group size, then the most senior Team Member present should pay the bill and submit for reimbursement.
finance__expenses.md:243:- Each Team Member must submit their own receipts for reimbursement, so ensure to separate billing when going to meals with groups of Team Members. If this is not practicable to do due to the group size, then the most senior Team Member present should pay the bill and submit for reimbursement.
finance__expenses.md:255:- Mileage is reimbursed according to local law, e.g.  US rate per mile, rate per km in the Netherlands, or rate in Belgium. Refer to "How Mileage Rates are Based" section below.
finance__expenses.md:275:- Yearly or Monthly Rail Discount cards are not reimbursable.
finance__expenses.md:305:- Internet while traveling is reimbursable for up to $50 USD (or local equivalent currency) per day.
finance__expenses.md:324:- If you are nursing while traveling on GitLab approved business, you can reimburse costs in order to travel with breast milk or ship your breast milk back home.
finance__expenses.md:330:- Check with your health plan to see if you are eligible for reimbursement for the cost of a breast pump or any other supplies.
finance__expenses.md:349:- Books are reimbursable if used to optimize your job position.
finance__expenses.md:369:- Coworking space is reimbursable for monthly space and one-off days during business travel. Pre-Approval is needed prior to submitting claims.
finance__expenses.md:373:- Coworking space is not reimbursable while on personal travel.
finance__expenses.md:379:- Travel to and from the co-working space, parking, meals, beverages, access cards, insurance and other additional expenses in a co-working facility are not reimbursable. Only the rent for the space is reimbursable.
finance__expenses.md:380:- If co-working space is used together with a combination of working from home, we will allow the reimbursement of the internet cost for where you spend most of your time. i.e. if you expense a co-working space for a full month then internet for home cannot be expensed. If you expense co-work for a few days in a month then home internet can be expensed in full.
finance__expenses.md:404:[Omitted long matching line]
finance__expenses.md:416:- As you onboard and start your GitLab journey, new hires will receive a 1,500 USD (or equivalent local currency) stipend to help you towards setting up your home office in your first year. Purchase the items you need using your own funds and submit a claim in Navan for reimbursement. Select the Expense Type: Work From Home – New Hire Stipend.
